changelog:
- Major update: Comprehensive Chinese web novel writing and review suite, featuring integrated "爆款引擎" (hit-creation engine) and "四十年读者巨著桌" (40-year veteran reviewer) for content generation and critique.
- Adds multi-path workflow (A–F): Quick start, outline-first, advanced Tomato (番茄) track, title/blurb, detailed review, and export for Tomato platform.
- Includes strict quality standards, modular routing based on user needs, and robust error handling with clear options for beginners and advanced users.
- Supports both writing (创作) and evaluation (评审) modes, with explicit guidelines for chapter hooks, word count, feedback mechanisms, and anti-template safeguards.
- Extended export tools, built-in review scripts, and topic/channel customization (女频, anti-AI, etc.).
- Dynamic interaction design: always asks clarifying questions, prevents ambiguous or bulk requests, and never guarantees platform success.
summary: 网文写作助手（爆款引擎·写审一体）：写小说/创作小说/生成小说/小说大纲/网文创作/番茄小说/起书名/写简介/网文评审/锐评/巨著桌/导出番茄/MD转TXT。含番茄专线、女频、上架文案、内置四十年读者巨著桌、export_fanqie导出脚本。当用户提到写小说、番茄小说、小说大纲、锐评、巨著桌、导出番茄、MD转TXT、番茄粘贴、网文写作助手时启用。
